title: 第7章 袁宝宝与玄昊第8章 薛如玉与薛伦
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
一把中品飞剑从储物袋中激射而出。
灵巧的飞到了李蒙脚下。
李蒙脚踩飞剑，御剑冲天而起。
眨眼间就消失在了天际边。
炼制淬灵丹还缺几味灵植，得去灵植园一趟。
合欢宗地界面积还是很大的。
从南到北足有一千多公里。
从东到西也不会少于五百公里。
宗内高耸入云的山峰比比皆是。
云雾缭绕的山峰透露着一丝仙家气派。
成为内门筑基弟子后，就能开辟自己的洞府。
可以在宗内找一处灵韵之地作为自己闭关修炼之地。
宗门弟子的修仙生活还是比较枯燥的。
外出做任务赚取贡献点。
用贡献点兑换修炼所需要的灵石与丹药。
然后闭关修炼。
灵石与丹药用完后再出关继续外出任务赚取贡献点。
就这么重复做着一件事。
就算破镜也不会有什么改变。
宗门任务反而会变得越来越危险。

练气弟子的任务相对来说较为安全。
任务也就那么几个。
凡人城镇轮值，守卫灵石矿，跟随筑基师叔外出任务。
只有筑基弟子才能接受一些战斗任务。
比如某个凡人城镇出现了妖魔。
宗门就会派遣筑基弟子前往凡人城镇斩妖除魔。
某个灵石矿被敌对宗门侵扰。
宗门就会派遣筑基弟子前往支援。
筑基弟子也是宗门的门面。
筑基弟子经常会接受一些前往修仙家族参加宴会的任务。
而这类任务筑基弟子往往会带着一些练气弟子充当门面。
至于金丹师祖，基本上都会在宗门内苦修。
也有一些金丹师祖会外出仙游，寻找破境机缘。
“李师兄，李师兄！”
就在李蒙御剑飞行穿梭于群峰间的云雾时。
一道轻灵悦耳的声音突然从远方传来。
声音由远而近，正在迅速的逼近。
一男一女两位外门练气弟子追上了李蒙。
男弟子一身青袍，好一个俊朗的儿郎。
女弟子一身青色的霓裳裙，娇小可人。

【姓名袁宝宝】
【年龄24】
content_en:
A mid-grade flying sword shot out from the storage bag.
He flew nimbly to Li Meng's feet.
Li Meng stepped on the flying sword, and the sword rose into the sky.
It disappeared into the sky in the blink of an eye.
We still need a few spiritual plants to refine the Spirit Tempering Pill, so we have to go to the Spiritual Plant Garden.
The boundary area of ​​Hehuan Sect is still very large.
It is more than a thousand kilometers from south to north.
It will not be less than 500 kilometers from east to west.
There are many towering peaks in the sect.
The mist-shrouded mountain peaks reveal a hint of fairyland style.
After becoming a foundation-building disciple of the inner sect, you can open your own cave.
You can find a spiritual place within the sect as a place for your own retreat and practice.
The life of sect disciples cultivating immortals is quite boring.
Go out and do tasks to earn contribution points.
Use contribution points to exchange for spiritual stones and elixirs needed for cultivation.
Then practice in seclusion.
After using up the spirit stones and elixirs, exit the game and continue the mission to earn contribution points.
Just doing one thing over and over again.
Even if the mirror is broken, nothing will change.
Instead, sect missions will become more and more dangerous.
The tasks of Qi training disciples are relatively safe.
There are only a few tasks.
Mortals take turns in towns, guarding the spirit stone mines, and following Uncle Foundation Builder on missions.
Only foundation-building disciples can accept some combat missions.
For example, a demon appeared in a certain mortal town.
The sect will send foundation-building disciples to kill demons in mortal towns.
A certain spirit stone mine was invaded by a hostile sect.
The sect will send foundation building disciples to support.
Foundation-building disciples are also the face of the sect.
Foundation-building disciples often accept tasks to attend banquets in the Immortal Cultivation Family.
For such tasks, foundation-building disciples often bring some Qi-training disciples with them to act as facades.
As for the Golden Pill Master, he basically practices hard in the sect.
There are also some golden elixir masters who will go out to travel among the immortals, looking for opportunities to break through the realm.
"Senior Brother Li, Senior Brother Li!"
Just when Li Meng was flying through the clouds and mist between the peaks with his sword.
A light and sweet voice suddenly came from afar.
The sound came from far away and was approaching rapidly.
Two outer disciples, a man and a woman, caught up with Li Meng.
The male disciple is dressed in a green robe and looks like a handsome boy.
The female disciple is wearing a cyan neon skirt, she is petite and pretty.
【Name Yuan Baobao】
【Age 24】
